title: Write a short function
summary: Kotlin: Write a short function. Call twice(7).
introduction: A function gives steps a name. This expression body returns n times two.
learningObjectives: Write a short function with Kotlin

blocks.text: Install a JDK and Kotlin. Save lesson.kt, run kotlinc lesson.kt -include-runtime -d lesson.jar, then java -jar lesson.jar.

blocks.title: Write a short function

blocks.text: The expression body after = returns n * 2. Input 4 gives 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Write a type for each function input.
